description: Keep your Homebox home inventory up to date from anywhere: add and find items, record purchases, warranties and serial numbers, attach receipts and photos, and log maintenance. Start a workflow when an item is added or changed, a warranty is about to run out, maintenance is due or something is running low.

homebox_item_quantity_low_trigger.description: Runs when an item's quantity is at or below the number you choose, such as to reorder filters. It runs again once the item has been restocked and runs low again. Items already that low when the workflow is turned on start it too.

output.asset_id: Its asset ID, such as 000-012 (blank when it has none)
output.id: The item's ID, which other Homebox steps take
output.link: Where the item opens in Homebox
output.location: The location it's in, such as Garage (blank when none)
output.name: The item's name
output.threshold: The quantity it is at or below
output.total_value: The purchase price times the quantity

parameters.description: Run when an item's quantity is this or less, such as 1.
parameters.name: quantity

parameters.description: Only items here or in a location inside it, such as Garage (its name, path or ID). Leave blank for every location.
parameters.name: location

parameters.description: Only items with this tag, such as Electronics (its name or ID). Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: tag

homebox_item_updated_trigger.description: Runs when an item is changed, such as moved, retagged, its quantity changed or a photo added, anywhere or in the location or with the tag you choose. An item only just added doesn't count.

output.asset_id: Its asset ID, such as 000-012 (blank when it has none)
output.id: The item's ID, which other Homebox steps take
output.link: Where the item opens in Homebox
output.location: The location it's in, such as Garage (blank when none)
output.name: The item's name
output.total_value: The purchase price times the quantity

parameters.description: Only items here or in a location inside it, such as Garage (its name, path or ID). Leave blank for every location.
parameters.name: location

parameters.description: Only items with this tag, such as Electronics (its name or ID). Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: tag

homebox_maintenance_due_trigger.description: Runs when a scheduled maintenance entry comes due, or the days you choose before, once for each scheduled date, such as to send a reminder. Maintenance already due when the workflow is turned on starts it too.

output.completed_date: When it was done (YYYY-MM-DD), blank when not done
output.days_until_due: Days until it's due (negative when overdue); empty when done or not scheduled
output.id: The entry's ID, which other Homebox steps take
output.item_id: The ID of the item it's for
output.item_name: The name of the item it's for
output.link: Where the item's maintenance log opens in Homebox
output.name: What the maintenance is
output.scheduled_date: When it's due (YYYY-MM-DD), blank when not scheduled

parameters.description: How many days before it's due to run: 0 for on the day. Leave blank for 0.
parameters.name: days

homebox_new_item_trigger.description: Runs when an item is added to the inventory, anywhere or in the location or with the tag you choose.

output.asset_id: Its asset ID, such as 000-012 (blank when it has none)
output.id: The item's ID, which other Homebox steps take
output.link: Where the item opens in Homebox
output.location: The location it's in, such as Garage (blank when none)
output.name: The item's name
output.total_value: The purchase price times the quantity

parameters.description: Only items here or in a location inside it, such as Garage (its name, path or ID). Leave blank for every location.
parameters.name: location

parameters.description: Only items with this tag, such as Electronics (its name or ID). Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: tag

homebox_warranty_expiring_trigger.description: Runs when an item's warranty is within the days you choose of running out, once for each warranty date, such as to remind you to check the item over. Warranties already that close when the workflow is turned on start it too.

output.days_left: Days until then (negative when already expired)
output.link: Where the item opens in Homebox
output.location: Where it is, such as Garage / Tool shelf
output.name: The item's name

parameters.description: How many days before a warranty runs out to run. Leave blank for 30.
parameters.name: days
